name: Bolt · Death
primary:
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). Effects:
• Damage 1.75 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 3 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4.4 s
• Life drain: 0.5 ❤ damage, you heal 0.2 ❤
